header.instrument: Per diem rates for the continental United States (CONUS), standard rate, 41 CFR Chapters 300-304. Meal breakdown per the GSA M&IE breakdown table; first and last day of travel at 75 percent per FTR 301-11.101
header.coverage: The STANDARD CONUS rate only. The roughly 300 non-standard localities (New York City, San Francisco, Seattle and the rest) are omitted: each is a separate lodging figure that changes every fiscal year and could not be stated with confidence here. A destination that is not a listed non-standard locality takes the standard rate anyway, which is what this table gives.
header.note: Lodging is a CAP on what may be reimbursed against receipts, not an allowance that is paid out. M&IE is the allowance.
